executionStates.live: A provider request was admitted and dispatched by the API.
executionStates.deterministic: The Minsk simulator evaluated declared workflow semantics without a provider request.
executionStates.disabled: A server-side provider switch or required configuration prevents dispatch.
executionStates.capacity_exhausted: A server-side allowance or application cap prevents dispatch; no provider request is made.
executionStates.unavailable: Provider availability could not be verified; no live action is represented as successful.
executionStates.fallback: A failed Wonder request was replaced by one admitted Spark provider request and is reported as a fallback.

vocabulary.workflow: A source-linked graph of conditions, policies, steps, dependencies and execution gates.
vocabulary.investigation: Advisory model activity that proposes evidence-linked questions or interventions.
vocabulary.counterfactual: An exact condition-value intervention evaluated against a retained baseline.
vocabulary.safeguard: A proposed execution-gate change verified by the deterministic simulator.
vocabulary.certificate: An integrity record binding source, workflow, trace and outcomes.
vocabulary.releaseCandidate: The candidate alias used to verify a commit before production promotion.
vocabulary.production: The canonical judge deployment on the main Pages branch.
